description: A FUNCTION-ID ... IS PROTOTYPE separate-compilation function prototype (ISO §2023:11.5 Format 2 / §2023:10.6 / §2023:12.3.8). A signature-only unit - LINKAGE-only data division + a header-only PROCEDURE DIVISION (§2023:10.6.2 SR4) - registers a signature but emits no runtime module; a same-name in-group DEFINITION (GR11a) or a separately-compiled sibling assembly is the activation target (§2023:8.4.3.2.4 GR6b -> EC-FUNCTION-NOT-FOUND on absence). LIVE (Phase 4c M2-UDF-3, DEVLOG 624). The IS PROTOTYPE tail is the `prototypePhrase` rule shared with PROGRAM-ID Format 2; below 2002 VersionConformancePass ParseArm.VisitPrototypePhrase names the edition (0900) on recognition (kb/Work PB894).
display: a FUNCTION-ID … IS PROTOTYPE (separate-compilation function prototype)
citation: ISO §2023:11.5 Format 2 / §2023:10.6 / §2023:12.3.8; §2023:10.6.2 SR4 (a signature-only unit); §2023:8.4.3.2.4 GR6b (EC-FUNCTION-NOT-FOUND)
vcr: M2 UDF catalog (PHASE4_RECONCILIATION M2-UDF-3); 2002 introduction (derive from the 2002 standard - Annex E covers 2014-2023 only)
source:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
FUNCTION-ID. FPROTO IS PROTOTYPE.
DATA DIVISION.
LINKAGE SECTION.
01 L-X PIC 9(4).
01 L-R PIC 9(6).
PROCEDURE DIVISION USING L-X RETURNING L-R.
END FUNCTION FPROTO.
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
PROGRAM-ID. VMFP1.
ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
CONFIGURATION SECTION.
REPOSITORY.
    FUNCTION FPROTO.
DATA DIVISION.
WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
01 W PIC 9(6).
PROCEDURE DIVISION.
MAIN.
    COMPUTE W = FUNCTION FPROTO(7).
    STOP RUN.
END PROGRAM VMFP1.
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
FUNCTION-ID. FPROTO.
DATA DIVISION.
LINKAGE SECTION.
01 L-X PIC 9(4).
01 L-R PIC 9(6).
PROCEDURE DIVISION USING L-X RETURNING L-R.
P.
    COMPUTE L-R = L-X * L-X.
    GOBACK.
END FUNCTION FPROTO.
